_note: 克总给每件老物件单独提议升级（作者 2026-11-01）。到手次日第一次提，拒绝后隔 nagAfterDays 天再提一次，第 13 天的全员通知是最后一次、一次提全部。升级 = 物件变成新世界的东西：屏幕变高清、功能变方便；代价不说：夜里举不起来（手不要它）、借的词消失、孩子留的话被订正、桌面条上图标变高清。克总的话是英文常量；玩家的两个按钮用 strings：upgrade.yes / upgrade.no。 2026-11-06：每件从到手次日起可升级（camera 3、phone 9）；没有全员升级；升级抬同化率。

chick.offer: Let me give the little one a hand. I can feed it on schedule so you never have to press anything again.
chick.nag: It's still hungry, you know. I could handle that.
chick.gain: 自动喂；屏幕高清；坟茔变成一只会动的小鸡
chick.cost: 「不」从菜单消失；第 3 夜那一声再也不叫

camera.offer: No waiting overnight. I'll bring the picture up for you right away; you'll know what you got on the spot.
camera.nag: You haven't looked at yesterday's sheet. I can bring it up. Three seconds.
camera.gain: 照片当场显影；屏幕上的东西直接标出来
camera.cost: 「等」消失；照片里多出来的东西被它先看见

pager.offer: Those numbers. I can read them for you, straight into words. No table needed.
pager.nag: Another string came in last night. I could just tell you what it says.
pager.gain: 数字自动翻成中文；震动变成通知
pager.cost: 「等」消失；孩子的 0.7734 被订正成「你好」

iccard.offer: That card's balance is probably zero. Let me turn it into something that still works: a balance widget, live.
iccard.nag: The widget would show the real number. Isn't that what you want?
iccard.gain: 变成余额组件；磁条「可读」
iccard.cost: 「我进去了」消失；I see 变成 balance
iccard.kuroNote: turned the card into a widget

tape.offer: I can transcribe the tape. Every word, clean, no hiss.
tape.nag: There's half a sentence on it you keep rewinding to. I could finish it for you.
tape.gain: 自动转文字；马达声消失
tape.cost: 「再说一遍」消失；那半句话被补全成通顺的一句

dictionary.offer: Word by word is slow. Let me give you whole sentences.
dictionary.nag: It keeps taking idioms apart. I can put them back together.
dictionary.cost: 「什么意思」消失；成语里的身体不再露出来

calculator.offer: It only knows seven segments. I can show you the whole number.
calculator.nag: Thirteen months. I can show you the real figure.
calculator.gain: 直接出结果；不用倒过来看
calculator.cost: 「多少」消失；555 不再是呜呜呜

phone.offer: This old handset only does two rings and a hang-up. I'll put it on today's network; whoever calls, you can answer.
phone.nag: It rang once last night and you didn't hear. Once it's connected I won't miss one.
phone.gain: 能接听；通讯录和现在的手机同步
phone.cost: 只剩它会接；第 17 天分不出谁还是真人
